messages:
tom (docs): opened PR to modernize SDK snippets: streaming + pagination + simple retry example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/534

nina (eng): thanks — I'll review TS + Python. are we changing APIs or only examples?

raj (sdk): only docs. naming: stream_generate for python, streamGenerate for TS/Go. I'll check Go snippet.

claire (qa): can we add a tiny CI sanity test that imports the examples and runs the async stream for one iteration?

tom (docs): added a minimal harness in the PR description you can run locally. pasted snippets below.

tom (docs): python snippet: async for chunk in client.stream_generate("Explain electron flow", max_tokens=120, retry_policy={"backoff":"exp","max_retries":2}): print(chunk.text)

tom (docs): ts snippet: const s = client.streamGenerate({prompt: "Explain electron flow", maxTokens: 120}); for await (const c of s) console.log(c.text)

tom (docs): go snippet: iter := client.ListEmbeddings(ctx, &redwood.ListEmbeddingsRequest{PageSize:50}); for iter.Next(){ item := iter.Item(); /* handle */ } if err := iter.Err(); err!=nil { /* retry */ } // next_cursor empty at EOF

raj (sdk): updated Go comments to mention next_cursor semantics. pushed small typo fix.

ci-bot: preview build for PR #534 succeeded (netlify-preview/534) :white_check_mark:

claire (qa): harness passed locally. small note: TS stream can coalesce very short outputs; added comment.

nina (eng): LGTM from me after the CI note.

tom (docs): will merge later today and add a short note in the changelog. thanks y'all.

claire (qa): filing follow-up issue to add a lightweight examples smoke test into examples/ci so streaming regressions are caught earlier.
